reason: The policy permits only two types of modifications to pending orders: (1) modifying items to different product options of the same product type, or (2) canceling the entire order. The requested action is removing specific items while keeping others, which is not supported. The policy explicitly states 'For a pending order, each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option,' requiring a valid correspondence between each modified item and a new item. An empty new_item_ids array does not satisfy this requirement. The agent incorrectly represented that item removal was achievable via the 'modify' action.
policy_references: For a pending order, each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option.
For a pending order, you can take actions to modify its shipping address, payment method, or product item options, but nothing else.
